_comment: Template. Copy this file to probe_config.json (gitignored) and fill in a real
password there — probe_config.json is never committed, so its passwords never
reach git history. This tracked file must never hold a real credential.
Servers are NOT defined here: 'profile' names a profile in ../../deploy_config.json,
which stays the single source of truth for endpoints. Leave 'profile' empty to
CRYSTORD_EMAIL / CRYSTORD_PASSWORD_<USER> / CRYSTORD_PASSWORD still override these
fields, for an account whose password you would rather not write to disk at all.
